1. **Electrical hazard (most relevant):** If the cable were live and suddenly cut, it could short, spark, or arc. With his right hand among the wiring and terminals, he could get an **electric shock or burn**, or a surge or arc inside the panel could reach his hand.

Real maintenance avoids these risks by cutting the power (lockout/tagout) before working on the panel.
